Verified local prototype · 24 October 2026

soulfire
Dynamic voice Witness mode

Open the local prototype and choose Simulations. Select Voice, Witnessed, and Model-generated conversation. Check save consent and the explicit paid-request budget, then launch when you want a real model run.

  • Dynamic user and guide turns are generated through the existing model adapter, then synthesized locally with Kokoro am_michael and af_heart. This is model-generated conversation + synthesized playback, not a microphone or Realtime speech-to-speech test.
  • Pause/Stop cancels generation or synthesis and releases playback. Saved turns/audio remain reviewable. Replay uses cached audio, or retries local synthesis from saved text, without new model requests.
  • Background jobs continue silently on the running local server after the tab closes. A server restart requires explicit resume; work is bounded to four model requests and a ten-minute window.
  • History remains opt-in and separate from personalization memory, with response feedback, export and deletion. Synthetic audio is private database storage with the same retention/deletion controls.

Passed: 83 unit tests, 116 full browser regressions, 18 focused browser checks, six final dynamic desktop/mobile checks, lint, types and final production build. Actual local synthesis, child-process cancellation, audio restart persistence/deletion, anonymous access denial and production paid-consent UI checks passed.

Evidence limits: model responses were mocked in validation; real local Kokoro synthesis and browser decoding/playback were exercised. No paid simulation was executed. No actual-user microphone audio, real reflections, or direct listening were used. These screenshots contain only fictional test data.
